description: Header file defining the VisualStudioWriter class and related structures for generating Visual Studio project and solution files within a build system.

classes.name: VisualStudioWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Visual Studio project and solution files, managing solution entries, projects, folders, and related configurations.

classes.name: SolutionEntry
classes.description: Represents a solution project or folder with name, path, guid, and parent folder reference.

classes.name: SolutionProject
classes.description: Derived from SolutionEntry, adds label directory path and configuration platform.

classes.name: SourceFileCompileTypePair
classes.description: Associates a source file with its compile type string.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFiles
methods.description: Static method to generate Visual Studio project and solution files based on build settings, builder, version, and other parameters.

methods.name: ResolveSolutionFolders
methods.description: Resolves parent folders for projects and updates folder structure.

methods.name: GetNinjaTarget
methods.description: Returns the ninja target string and whether the target is phony.
